name: Anand Gupta
headline: AI systems with product judgment.
intro: I build LLM systems for clinical and real-time conversational contexts, with a bias toward products that are useful, measurable, and humane.

availability: Open to thoughtful conversations, writing collaborations, and AI product discussions.
